title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Detecting Antisemitism
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the performance of LLMs in detecting antisemitism, which targets a group defined by religious and ethnic identity. The study evaluates models' adherence to socio-ethical moderation policies (IHRA definition) and includes a qualitative analysis of misclassifications in categories such as 'Religious' beliefs and ethical tones like sarcasm and stereotypes.
